name: SBI (State Bank of India)
faq1: SBI home loan interest rates start from 8.50% p.a. depending on your CIBIL score. Use our calculator to compute your exact monthly EMI and interest payout schedule.
faq2: SBI allows partial prepayment and foreclosure with zero penalty for floating interest rate home loans.

name: HDFC Bank
faq1: HDFC home loan interest rates currently start from 8.70% p.a. Calculate your exact monthly EMI for home, car, and personal loans.
faq2: HDFC offers up to 30 years repayment tenure for home loans, lowering your monthly EMI liability.

name: ICICI Bank
faq1: ICICI Bank loan EMI depends on principal amount, interest rate (8.75%+), and tenure (up to 30 years for home loans).
faq2: Prepaying ICICI Bank loans directly reduces outstanding principal, lowering total interest paid over the tenure.

name: Axis Bank
faq1: Axis Bank provides competitive EMI plans for home, car, and personal loans starting at 8.75% p.a. interest.
faq2: Axis Bank loan tenure ranges up to 30 years for home financing and up to 7 years for auto loans.

name: PNB (Punjab National Bank)
faq1: PNB home loan interest rates are among the lowest in India, starting at 8.45% p.a. for high CIBIL applicants.
faq2: PNB imposes no prepayment penalty on floating rate retail loans.

name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
faq1: Kotak Mahindra Bank offers quick online loan approval with home loan rates starting at 8.70% p.a.
faq2: Kotak personal loan EMIs can be calculated using the principal, monthly rate, and tenure formula.
